title: Restore iOS export by declaring the missing Apple authentication runtime dependency
body:
## Problem

The iOS Expo export fails because Apple authentication 2.5.1 imports prop-types without providing it, and Little Say's workspace does not declare the runtime dependency. The same failure reproduces on current master and PR35; it was introduced with the merged account integration and is separate from prompt-resource extraction.

The user explicitly approved a separate dependency-fix PR on October 8. [Retained baseline and PR35 reproduction logs](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/524cf7aa5866abf105537e882192325ca812615e/README.md#results) show module resolution failing in AppleButton.ios.js.

## Requirements and acceptance

- Declare the missing maintained runtime dependency in the appropriate mobile application manifest and update the lockfile proportionately.
- A fresh locked installation must complete the iOS JavaScript export without the missing-module error.
- Preserve web/Android exports, account provider behavior and applicable repository/release checks.
- Keep the published change focused: no unrelated dependency upgrades, lockfile churn, provider redesign or PR35 prompt edits.
- Do not claim signed iOS/TestFlight delivery or real Apple sign-in from a successful JavaScript export.

## Implementation plan

Verify current master and the exact Apple authentication import/dependency graph. Add the smallest production dependency declaration needed by the mobile app, regenerate the lockfile with the repository's expected package-manager version and inspect the complete dependency diff. Reproduce with a fresh locked install and run iOS, web and Android exports plus relevant checks. Keep failed-baseline and successful-final logs in accessible retained evidence outside product history.

No credentials, signed build, paid cloud build, provider call, release or deployment is needed or authorized.

## Implementing Codex task

Queued for the completed read-only investigator, verified task ID `01a11ca6-7faa-7628-8031-ac89bc018019`, as a distinct outcome and separate branch. No implementation turn admitted yet. Historical account integration owner `01a10f7a-bf1e-7154-8695-468b946d4021` is verified completed/idle; PR29 is merged. PR35 remains separate.

## Implementing PR

Not created.
